observations: Photo 0: Two tables with cast-iron treadle sewing-machine bases, one with a blue-patterned top, one with a wood-grain laminate top; each top has a rectangular cutout where a sewing machine head would sit, no machine head present; outdoor dirt setting.
Photo 1: Same two tables viewed from above, confirming cast-iron treadle legs and belt mechanism under each, cutout in each tabletop empty, watermark 'SESHMAK TECH' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

Photo 2: Close view of the blue-patterned-top table, cutout empty showing ground below, a ruler/measuring strip printed along the front edge of the top, iron scrollwork legs and treadle pedal visible underneath.
Photo 3: Close view of the wood-grain-top table, cutout filled with tiled/mosaic insert rather than open ground, iron treadle wheel and pedal visible, a green object partly visible at left edge.

identity.kind: sewing machine table/stand (treadle base, no machine head)

not_shown: Condition and functionality of the treadle mechanism (whether wheel turns smoothly, belt included)
Stability of the iron legs (rust, cracks, repairs)
Whether a sewing machine head is included or sold separately
Material and thickness of the tabletops (solid wood vs laminate/veneer condition)
Any woodworm, warping, or water damage to the tops
Completeness of hardware (drawers, knee lever, bobbin holder, etc.)
